# 0.5.3

## 本次更新

- 修复推荐页滑到底后无法继续加载：之前翻页是否继续取决于底部两张预览图是否对齐
  （masonry 两列底端高度），对齐时就卡住，必须先上滑再下滑；现在贴底即触发下一页，
  与卡片高度对齐无关。

- Fixes the recommendation feed stalling at the bottom: whether the next page
  loaded used to depend on the bottom two preview cards' heights being aligned
  (the masonry columns ending flush), which froze the feed until the user
  scrolled up and back down. The feed now loads the next page on any bottom
  drag regardless of card alignment.
